correctness.rationale: Eq. (3.5) fixes a nonconstant conditional posterior pi(nu|gamma,eta,xi). Eq. (3.10) instead shows pi*_nu(nu*,var(nuhat))/pi*_nu(nu_old,var(nuhat)). Read literally, its arguments are undefined as a posterior; read as a normal-proposal density, the posterior ratio disappears. For a symmetric normal random walk Hastings terms cancel and valid alpha=min(1,pi(new)/pi(old)). A symmetric displacement-only acceptor and symmetric proposal cannot satisfy detailed balance for this nonconstant target. Independent log-density evaluation on the stated five-point dataset gives ratio 3.844679306266 vs displacement factor .324652467358 at variance .04. Only the printed rule, not unavailable implementation, is assessed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general MH identity supplies the correction but does not itself identify the 2025 article error or validate its data-specific posterior. Distinguish classical method from source-specific observation.
